user.title: Druckwerk bridge
user.description: Address of the Druckwerk bridge API.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the add-on at this URL.

init.title: Druckwerk
init.description: Upload secret: agents upload sliced files with PUT /api/druckwerk/upload/<name>.gcode.3mf and the header X-Druckwerk-Secret (empty turns uploads off). Hub secret: normally set by app discovery; paste it here otherwise (empty keeps the current one). Recipients: YAML map of person entity to notify service, e.g. person.anna: notify.mobile_app_anna; they are notified only while at home.

error.invalid_hub_secret: The hub rejected this secret or is not reachable.

integration_too_old.title: Update the Druckwerk integration
integration_too_old.description: The Druckwerk app speaks a newer interface than this integration. Update the Druckwerk integration in HACS and restart Home Assistant.

app_too_old.title: Update the Druckwerk app
app_too_old.description: The Druckwerk app is too old to offer actions and tools. Update the Druckwerk app.

bad_manifest.title: Druckwerk app sent a manifest the integration cannot apply
bad_manifest.description: The Druckwerk app sent an action or tool with a value this integration does not know, so the new manifest is not applied and the actions keep their last working state. Update the Druckwerk integration in HACS and restart Home Assistant; the app and the integration may be out of step.

hub_secret_rejected.title: Druckwerk app rejected the hub secret
hub_secret_rejected.description: The Druckwerk app answered 401: the hub secret of this integration is wrong. Open the Druckwerk integration options and paste the current hub secret, or restart the app so that discovery sets it again.
